texts.zh:
到达不久后，我们着陆在一个岩石基座上，它的尺寸恰好与裂隙探球相合。事实上，这个位置与我们的需求吻合到说是巧合也未免太勉强了。

一片广阔而灿烂的天空在我们的四面八方伸展开去。初步扫描显示，我们正坐在一座巨大的塔顶，塔底被涌动的云层挡住了视线。

在底座的边缘有一位孤独的生物。它穿着一件破烂的、满是灰尘的长袍，显然在等着迎接我们。
texts.en:
Soon after arrival, we touched down on a stone pedestal that conforms perfectly to the dimensions of the Rift Sphere. In fact, the location is so obviously suited to our needs that the idea of it being a coincidence has been rejected out of hand.

In all directions, a vast and radiant sky stretches before us. Initial scans indicate we are sitting atop a massive tower, the bottom of which is blocked from view by the swirling layers of cloud.

At the edge of the pedestal is a solitary creature. It wears a tattered, dusty robe, and is apparently waiting to greet us.

label.en: Attempt to communicate with the creature.
Observe the creature and report back.

texts.zh:
由于无法翻译这个生物的语言，我们干脆用一种更直接的方式进行沟通，间断地闪亮裂隙探球的外部灯光。

这个生物一下子跪到了地上。我们一开始还以为是我们伤到了他，但很快发现他是在表达某种赞美或者恳求。

不久之后，一群穿着相似的生物围到了基座边上，他们手中拿着一个篮子，其中装的东西我们大概只能推测是礼物之类的东西。
texts.en:
With no means of fully translating the creature's language, we resorted to a more direct form of communication, intermittently flashing the Rift Sphere's external lights.

Within moments, the creature fell to the ground. At first we were concerned that we had harmed it, but it soon became clear that it was simply offering some sort of praise or supplication.

Not long after, a coterie of similarly dressed beings approached the pedestal, each bearing a basket of what we can only assume to be gifts.

texts.zh:
我们打开了舱门，这个生物犹犹豫豫地走了进来。

他每迈出一步，步伐就变得自信了一些，但仍然可以看出他浑身每一寸都高度紧绷着。谁知道他到底等待这一刻的到来有多长时间了。

我们不确定他如何知道我们会到来，但我们确定把它带上来应该不会有什么问题。他对着我们船上的仪器瞠目结舌，很快就惊得昏阙在了甲板地上。

在对他藏在袍子里的文件进行了一些修复和研究之后，我们得出了这样的结论：这个特殊的生物是同类中具有一定影响力的领袖。

我们认为，通过一些整合，他们将对我们自己的社会有很大的好处。
texts.en:
We opened our vessel, and the creature tentatively approached.

With each step it gained more confidence, but we could tell its vital systems were highly elevated. How long has it waited for this moment to take place?

We are not sure how it knew we would be coming, but we are sure it is safe to bring aboard. It gasped in awe at the instruments of our vessel. Overcome with excitement, it quickly passed out onto the deck plating.

After some rehabilitation and study of the documents it had rolled up inside of its robes, we were able to reach the conclusion that this particular creature is an influential leader among its peers.

We think, with some integration, they would be a great benefit to our own society.

tooltips.zh: 一位科学官将在一年后被招募。
tooltips.en: A Scientist will be recruited after one year.

label.zh: 扣押他的文件，然后把他放走。
label.en: Confiscate their documents and release them.

tooltips.zh: 获得一个随机的社会学科技。
tooltips.en: Randomly gain a new Society Technology.

texts.zh:
一年前，我们从星界裂隙另一端的一座巨塔带回了一个个体。从那以来，[From.GetHeShe]越来越适应我们社会。现在[From.GetHisHer]已经能说我们的语言，而帮助我们的初心不变。

[From.GetHeShe]展现了对社会哲学的独到见解，给予了我们一个特殊的机会。
texts.en:
Over a year ago, we recovered an individual from the great tower beyond the Astral Rift. In the time since, [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetHasHave] become well acclimated to our society. Now able to speak our language, [From.GetHisHer] enthusiasm to assist us has never waned.

This presents us with a unique opportunity, as [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetHasHave] shown excellent understanding of social psychology.

label.zh: [From.GetHeSheCap]作为一名普通公民就很好了。
label.en: [From.GetHeSheCap] serve[From.GetSXX] us better as a citizen.

texts.zh:
领袖[From.GetName]已然与世长辞。[From.GetHeShe]远自星界裂隙彼端而来，如今被隆重地安葬。葬礼在裂隙另一端的高塔内巨型，通过一台特殊建造的葬礼球体转播。我们希望[From.GetHeShe]能在彼世踏上新的旅程。

[From.GetHeShe]对我们帝国的卓著贡献将被长久铭记。
texts.en:
Sadly, the leader [From.GetName] has passed away. Joining us from beyond an Astral Rift, [From.GetHeShe] [From.GetWasWere] buried with honors. The ceremony took place within the tower on the far side of the rift, and was observed from a specially made funeral Sphere. We hope [From.GetHeShe] find[From.GetSXX] a new adventure in whatever lies beyond.

The significant impact [From.GetHeShe] had on our empire will long be remembered.

texts.zh:
我们不会再过多打扰他们了。

我们的到来似乎以外地满足了某种远古语言。他们不知为何预知我们会来，并且鉴于他们对此的高度重视，这趟访问好像对他们的文明产生了显著的影响。

我们决定留下几块先进的金属作为小礼物，以表好意。其中一块上我们刻上了我们母星系的数学坐标，他们也许有朝一日能按图索骥联系上我们。

为了对我们的社会学家有所帮助，我们为后代记录了整个互动过程。
texts.en:
We will not disturb them further.

Our very arrival seems to have accidentally fulfilled some ancient prophecy. Somehow, they knew we were coming, and given the profound importance they placed on it, our arrival is likely to have a significant effect on their civilization.

We have decided to leave a small gift of advanced metals behind, as evidence of our good will. On one of these, we inscribed the mathematical location of our home system, should they ever find their way to us.

In the hope it will prove useful to our sociologists, we have recorded the entire interaction for posterity.

texts.zh:
处理掉这些[Explorer.GetPreFTLLower]生物后，我们继续开始探索该异次元的大气。

我们把注意力集中到资源提取上，成功获取了周围云朵的样品，其中包含这异常高浓度的星界物质。我们很欢迎这种意外收获。
texts.en:
With the [Explorer.GetPreFTLLower] creatures dealt with, we continued our explorations of the extradimensional atmosphere.

Refocusing our efforts towards resource extraction, we managed to collect samples from the surrounding clouds, which contain extraordinarily high concentrations of astral material. An unusual - but welcome - bounty.

texts.zh:
我们不会再参与这种误导性的盛典了。

建造这座塔就是个错误，我们有更重要的事情要做而不是帮助实现外星人的预言。

我们把注意力集中到资源提取上，成功获取了周围云朵的样品，其中包含这异常高浓度的星界物质。我们很欢迎这种意外收获。
texts.en:
We will take no further part of this misguided pageantry.

The building of this tower was a mistake, and we have better things to do than help to enact some alien prophecy.

Refocusing our efforts towards resource extraction, we managed to collect samples from the surrounding clouds, which contain extraordinarily high concentrations of astral material. An unusual - but welcome - bounty.

texts.zh:
我们安全地待在球体内，花费了一些时间调查这个地方。这里离地的高度大约是2500米，对于这种科技发展水平的社会来说，要建造如此高度的摩天巨塔显然要花费难以想象的努力。事实上，我们甚至正在见证这个文明首次进入太空的尝试。更奇怪的是，这个岩石基座上雕刻着一些似乎与在裂隙探球内找到的相同的图案。

这个生物骄傲地站在我们面前，张开双臂。这显然是一个欢乐的时刻。
texts.en:
From the safety of the Sphere, we spent some time investigating the site. Our altitude is estimated at around 2,500 meters. It must have been a great effort for a society at this level of technological development to construct a spire at such a height. In fact, we may be looking at this civilization's first effort at reaching space. Even more intriguingly, the stone pedestal is carved with markings and illustrations that look nearly identical to those found inside the Rift Sphere.

The creature stands proudly before us, its arms stretched wide. This is clearly a joyous moment.

texts.zh:
裂隙球从仪式巨塔高高升起，这一定让下面的生物产生了某种具有精神意义的时刻。不幸的是，紧接着我们的飞船以极限速度坠落，摧毁了基座附近的所有生命形式。他们默默地站着，举起手臂，直到最后一刻。

现在我们可以继续不受任何干扰探索这个环境了。
texts.en:
The raising of the Rift Sphere high above the ceremonial tower must have inspired a moment of spiritual significance for the beings below. Unfortunately for them, it was followed quickly by the drop of our vessel at terminal velocity, obliterating all lifeforms near the pedestal. They stood silently, arms raised, until the very end.

Now we may continue to explore this environment without further disturbance.
